861:t_011:11.en:
$$アポロ$$
「The rest of you play however you like. Honestly, I'm still nowhere near full... Anyway, see ya!」

861:t_012:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Oh... break time? I'm getting hungry too, so perfect timing.」

861:t_012:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Can't play games on an empty stomach. Once we've eaten, let's fight together again.」

861:t_012:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Later! And you, make sure you eat plenty of good food too!」

861:t_013:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Huh? Special training, now? I'm not wasting my time on that.」

861:t_013:4.en:
$$シリウス$$
「It's necessary if we're to win the battles ahead. Never mind that, we're starting, $$アポロ$$.」

861:t_013:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then do it by yourself. The training topic is 'Read the quit message with your combination face.'」

861:t_013:6.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Players, everyoooone! Plaaay agaaain! I'm counting on yoooou!!」

861:t_013:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「...You win this time, $$シリウス$$...」

861:t_014:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, you're stopping here? Good work. Then I'll go next...」

861:t_014:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$千鳥$$. A simulation is meaningless unless it's run on accurate data.」

861:t_014:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Attacking a fighter plane with a monomolecular cutter is impossible in reality. It's utter nonsense.」

861:t_014:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, how can you casually say something that denies the whole foundation of this game?」

861:t_014:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Never mind that, hand over the data. I'll adjust the stats to be as combat-realistic as possible...」

861:t_015:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ugh, enough! Stop with the fumo-fumo, it's so loud!」

861:t_015:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Be sure to polish your gun thoroughly before bed!」

861:t_015:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Make that 'teeth,' would you? That part, at least...」

861:t_016:3.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Use Valor! How can you not take out the enemies closing in on us?!」

861:t_016:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「No, this is where we should use Alert and run away!」

861:t_016:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You charge in without thinking, which is why you got Game Over ten times!」

861:t_016:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So what! That's way better than a captain who's useless in real operations!」

861:t_016:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Grr! That's it! Let's have $$相良$$ decide!」

861:t_016:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Which is it, $$宗介$$?! Valor?! Alert?!」

861:t_017:3.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are you doing here, Sergeant?」

861:t_017:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Sergeant, I trust you naturally have Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ as an ace?」

861:t_017:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「The TDD-1 is a submarine, so by its nature terrain adaptation is a weak point...」

861:t_017:7.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Is that an excuse?」

861:t_017:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Listen well. With that ship and the Captain's abilities, we must show that terrain adaptation is no obstacle whatsoever!」

861:t_017:10.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「And if you say you cannot do that, Sergeant... I will stuff you into a torpedo tube and fire you out along with 300 kilograms of explosives!」

861:t_017:11.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「I swear by God and Her Majesty the Queen, I intend to tear you limb from limb! Do you understand?!」

861:t_018:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Whew, finally done! ...Or so I thought. What are you doing, $$宗介$$?」

861:t_018:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Studying. I have a test soon. 1185, let's make... the Muromachi Shogunate.」

861:t_018:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「It's Kamakura, I'm telling you! Are you really gonna get your credits like that?」

861:t_018:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Japanese history is not my strong suit...」

861:t_018:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「To all you student players: don't turn out like $$宗介$$!」

861:t_018:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Play in moderation, and study a decent amount, too!」

861:t_019:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Whoa! You look terrible! Why not rest along with the player?」

861:t_019:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't do that! As someone entrusted with everyone's lives, I must always come up with the best strategy...」

861:t_019:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Hey, wait, $$メリッサ$$! Where are you touching?! That tickles~!」

861:t_019:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「There, that's the face! Scrunching up your brow isn't cute at all.」

861:t_019:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Honestly! You could have just told me to rest! Fine, I'll rest properly.」

861:t_019:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「Good, honest answer! Well, to the player too, see ya~!」

861:t_020:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh, you're stopping here. Good work.」

861:t_020:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Resting well when you can is an important duty too.」

861:t_020:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But once you've had a good rest, please be sure to come back here.」

861:t_020:6.en:
$$テッサ$$
「This is a request, not an order. I'll be waiting for you the whole time, you know.」

861:t_021:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Suspending, huh? Good timing. Take a nice, long break.」

861:t_021:4.en:
$$アル$$
「A word of advice. Rest is impossible while your nerves are on edge. I recommend a joke to ease your state of mind.」

861:t_021:6.en:
$$アル$$
「A joke, a witticism, warms up the atmosphere when used. Sergeant, please share a first-rate joke.」

861:t_021:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Then we will have one prepared by the next opportunity... Everyone, please look forward to it.」

861:t_022:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh, taking a break here? Impressive. Straining yourself won't get you anywhere anyway.」

861:t_022:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So, how about watching a movie to change the mood?」

861:t_022:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Right now our team leader happens to be enjoying his favorite classic kids' anime...」

861:t_022:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oops, that's the Lieutenant's top secret.」

861:t_022:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm slipping out, so make up some excuse for me! See ya!」

861:t_023:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oh, taking a break here? Impressive. Straining yourself won't get you anywhere anyway.」

861:t_023:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「So, how about watching a movie to change the mood?」

861:t_023:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Right now our team leader happens to be enjoying his favorite classic kids' anime...」

861:t_023:7.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Oops, that's the Captain's top secret.」

861:t_023:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm slipping out, so make up some excuse for me! See ya!」

861:t_024:4.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What matters is balance. In games and in life.」

861:t_024:5.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Too much of anything is bad! In other words, it's baaad!」

861:t_024:6.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「This is what happens when you ignore the warning and overdo it.」
